description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You draw an Overflow effect.

Draw a second Overflow effect immediately, of the same rank or lower. The Reckoning advances only once for the pair, not twice. Both effects must be drawn as part of the same Litany, and if you cannot draw the second, the free action is spent anyway.

cinderfall.incomplete: The 'Reckoning advances only once, not per draw' clause for a free second Overflow draw -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER). Separately: no generic 'cast a second, arbitrary spell for free' hook exists either.
